contracts.blurb: Staff on training courses stay in your rooms and use your hall.
Your Abuja tower hosts their quarterly meetings and members' rooms.
Holiday packages fill your villas every December.

contracts.buyer: Port Harcourt Oil Services Crew Desk
contracts.blurb: Field crews book rooms on a monthly contract.
Ghanaian companies book your Lagos rooms for business trips.
Families coming home for December book room blocks early.

belt.name: Self-Rolling Linen Cart
belt.blurb: Carries clean linen and toiletries from the laundry to the rooms on its own.

auto.name: Service Lift and Chute
auto.blurb: Lifts food to the hall and upper rooms; drops used linen straight to the laundry.

pack.name: Central Laundry Plant
pack.blurb: Washes, dries and delivers linen for every room and hall with no carrying at all.

milestones.title: Second Hotel
milestones.blurb: A new signboard, the same brass key and the same warm welcome.

milestones.title: Five Hotels
milestones.blurb: Travellers across Lagos know the Adunni Palms welcome.

milestones.title: Abuja and Beyond
milestones.blurb: Every branch passes inspection on the first visit.

milestones.title: Every Region
milestones.blurb: Hotels in the North, East and South-South, each with its own manager.

milestones.title: Solar on Every Roof
milestones.blurb: Generators rest most nights. Guests sleep in quiet.

milestones.title: Across Africa
milestones.blurb: Accra and Zanzibar open with local teams and local licences.

milestones.title: Hospitality Academy
milestones.blurb: Young Nigerians train as chefs, housekeepers and managers.

milestones.title: The Seven-City Crown
milestones.blurb: Aunty's brass key hangs in every lobby, from Surulere to London.

staff: Toiletries are low, bring a carton.
Hall is dressed for the training.
customer: Is there a room for tonight?
The bed was so clean, thank you.
We need the hall for Saturday.
Can I check in before two?
I will come back in December.
manager: Every room was ready by two, ma.
Tank is half full. Diesel is cheaper this week.
The tax box is complete for the 20th.
Stewards are ready for the conference.
Reviews are climbing. Guests like the breakfast.
Inspector visits next month. Checklist is green.
night: Four rooms and one bucket. Look at us now.
Buy diesel when it is cheap, not when it is dark.
Tax money is never mine. Keep it in the box.
Guests remember how you treat them.
Tomorrow I check the fire exits first.

events.name: Light Don Go
events.text: Grid power is out all evening. The generator works hard and costs more today.

events.name: Wedding Party Arrives
events.text: A wedding party books rooms for the weekend. Guests spend more today.

events.name: One-Star Review
events.text: A guest posts about a stained pillow. Fewer bookings today. Check every room.

events.name: Conference Delegation
events.text: Forty delegates arrive for a three-day training. More guests today.

events.name: Burst Pipe on Floor Two
events.text: Water floods two rooms. The repair costs extra today.

events.name: Nollywood Crew Checks In
events.text: A film crew shoots in your lobby. More people book today.

events.name: Supply Van Stuck
events.text: The supply van is stuck in traffic. Linen and food arrive slowly today.

events.name: Inspection Passed
events.text: The inspector finds every exit clear and every record neat. A small grant arrives for staff training.
